bullets: I'm a junior web developer with a base in React/Next.js and PHP/Laravel.
I did my internship in a team: a parking management desktop application and a corporate intranet.
I build full-stack projects with public code. I use AI as a development tool and validate the code with tests.

experience_list.title: Web Developer (internship)
highlights: Team development, sharing the work with another developer, of every module of a parking management desktop application (React, Electron): free spaces, payments and receipts, cash register, subscriptions, parking users, staff shifts, barrier control and camera viewing.
Evolution of the corporate intranet (React, PHP, MySQL): new features, table design and issue resolution.
Version control with Git and Bitbucket.

experience_list.title: IT Technician (internship)
highlights: Installation, configuration and maintenance of computers, networks and cabling.
User support and technical issue resolution.
